ci_logout_regression.cause: The browser test checked /api/auth/me immediately after clicking logout, before POST /api/auth/logout completed; the session could correctly still return 200.
ci_logout_regression.reproduction: Holding the real logout request behind an explicit gate reproduced the same expected-401/received-200 failure locally before the fix.
ci_logout_regression.fix: All browser logout paths wait for the POST response and entry UI, then replay the original cookie and require 401. The gated scenario also checks that the app remains signed in with a disabled logout button while the request is pending.
ci_logout_regression.scope: Test synchronization only; no application, authentication policy, CI retries or timeout changes.
